results.description:
Healthcare burnout is all too common, and by looking back onto positive interactions with peers and patients we may be reminded of our motivations for choosing these careers.

Komorebi (木漏れ日), the word for sunlight coming through leaves, is somewhere to put it down. The bad to process, and the good to reflect back on.

Pick how the day went. If it was a mixed emotions day, select two. Take a prompt if a blank page is too much. These were written for this work, not adapted from a general journaling app:

"What did you have to let go of today because there wasn't enough time?"
"What's the gap between the care you wanted to give and the care you could give?"
"What are you leaving at the hospital door before you go home?"
"What do you wish someone had asked you today?"
"Who on your team do you want to thank, and for what?"

WHAT THE TREE IS FOR

Each set of entries creates leaves. Write more and the tree fills in. That's the entire mechanic.

There are no streaks. Nothing breaks if you skip a week, or a month, or a whole rotation of nights. The app will not send you a notification asking where you've been. Come back after eight weeks and the tree is where you left it, with everything you wrote still in it.

YOUR WRITING DOES NOT LEAVE YOUR PHONE

There is nothing to sign up for, no email, no password.
There is no analytics, nor tracking of any kind.
The app makes no network requests. Not for sync, not for backup, not for anything.

One thing to know before you start: because entries live only on your device, deleting the app deletes them with it. There is no cloud copy to restore from.

Lumen Grimoire is your year-long illuminated journal. Each day you write a reflection — what you're carrying, what you noticed, what kept you up — and the app brings forward a Companion from a deck of 366 original cards, matched to what you wrote. Across the year you collect them all. Across the year, you author your own book.

This is not a notes app. This is not a generic journal where entries pile up unread. Lumen Grimoire pairs your thoughts with meaning. Each Companion has its own archetype, mood, and place in the year. Each reflection becomes part of your codex — a personal manuscript no other user will ever have.

THE COMPANIONS

366 original cards, designed and created specifically for this app and nothing else — plus a special tribute card unique to the deck. A DAILY PRACTICE
